generated_for: SENSOR-B4-I17 BLOC 5 HANDOFF - schema identity, versioning and compatibility freeze

historical_descriptor_compatibility.carry_forward_id: known limitation item D from the I16R2 ratification
distinguishable_states: HISTORICAL_UNIT_CONTRACT_ABSENT (no marker and no declaration - the third, distinct state)
historical_descriptor_compatibility.law: Pre-I16R1 descriptors carry no unit metadata. They remain VALID historical contracts and continue to verify against their historical fingerprints.
prohibited_retroactive_reads: an absent contract marker MUST NOT be read as NO_UNIT_FIELDS
an absent declaration list MUST NOT be read as VERIFIED_NATIVE
an absent marker with an empty list MUST NOT be read as UNIT_EVIDENCE_DECLARED

identity_mechanisms.compatibility_matrix_law: This repository enforces semver FORM and identity uniqueness ONLY. It defines NO major/minor/patch compatibility semantics, no additive/backward/forward guarantees and no deprecation policy. Bloc 5 must not infer any of these from the version numbers and must not invent them; if a downstream policy is needed it must be authored and ratified separately.

projection_schema_id.law: Nonempty stable logical name. Paired with projection_schema_version it forms schema_identity.

projection_schema_version.answers: WHICH declared revision of that schema
projection_schema_version.law: Strict semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, validated by validate_semver(): no prerelease, no leading zeros. Anything else raises ValueError.

schema_fingerprint.answers: WHAT EXACT FIELD STRUCTURE WAS REGISTERED
schema_fingerprint.formula: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of: every provider-native field (name, Arrow logical type, nullable), the full ordered _t0_* metadata schema (name, type, nullable), the canonical source_unit_evidence list sorted by resolved_field_path, and the source_unit_contract marker when declared
schema_fingerprint.law: Structure only. Separate question from schema_key; neither substitutes for the other.

schema_key.law: Identity only. Registry self-consistency is validated on load: a stored key must hash from the stored id and version.

method: Read from the frozen implementation at the start head: projection_schema.compute_schema_key, projection_schema.compute_schema_fingerprint, projection_schema.validate_semver, ProjectionSchemaDefinition construction, ProjectionSchemaRegistry.register/resolve/resolve_by_id, export.PACK_SCHEMA_VERSION, and the pydantic model_fields of each public handoff model. No versioning policy is invented here; only enforced behavior is recorded.

registry_semantics.conflict: ProjectionSchemaConflict(schema_id, schema_version) is raised when the same schema_id + schema_version already exists with a DIFFERENT fingerprint. It is a ValueError subclass.
registry_semantics.consequence_for_bloc5: A changed schema structure under an unchanged id+version is REJECTED, not silently accepted. To change structure, register a NEW projection_schema_version.
registry_semantics.corruption: ProjectionSchemaCatalogCorrupt (RuntimeError) when a committed registry fragment is corrupt; the registry fails closed.
registry_semantics.not_found: ProjectionSchemaNotFound (KeyError subclass) for an unregistered schema_key or id+version.
registry_semantics.register: Idempotent for an exact duplicate (same id+version, same fingerprint). Returns the registered ProjectionSchemaDefinition.
registry_semantics.resolution: resolve(schema_key) or resolve_by_id(schema_id, schema_version). has(schema_key) and list_keys() are public.

laws: A provider-native schema field beginning with _t0_ is rejected with ReservedProjectionColumn; the T0B layer injects those columns.
Every component of SourceUnitEvidence.field_path beginning with _t0_ is rejected.
reserved_and_validated_namespaces.structural_path_law: A unit path is a tuple, never a dotted string. Component 0 must be a top-level provider-native field; a component under list/large_list must equal the Arrow list value-field name; a component under struct must name a struct child field; any other intermediate type is not traversable; the terminal must be a string field. Every violation fails closed with a typed ValueError.

schema_compatibility_table.compatibility_behavior: Pydantic model; additive fields are the only sanctioned change. No batch-level schema version field exists.
schema_compatibility_table.identity_mechanism: Carries the projection schema identity; the row-level meaning of raw_rows_or_reader is defined by that registered schema.

schema_compatibility_table.compatibility_behavior: Additive only. Changing any field changes the owner fingerprint and therefore requires a new projection_schema_version.
schema_compatibility_table.identity_mechanism: Versioned indirectly through the owning ProjectionSchemaDefinition fingerprint.

schema_compatibility_table.compatibility_behavior: Same id+version with a different fingerprint is a hard conflict; no compatibility matrix.
schema_compatibility_table.identity_mechanism: schema_key for identity, schema_fingerprint for structure; both derived deterministically.

schema_compatibility_table.compatibility_behavior: A projection whose declared schema version does not match the artifact is rejected at read/export time.
schema_compatibility_table.identity_mechanism: projection_sha256 is the durable artifact digest; state is a typed ProjectionState.

schema_compatibility_table.compatibility_behavior: Append-only acquisition facts; resume tokens are opaque.
schema_compatibility_table.identity_mechanism: request_fingerprint identifies the request; adapter_version/capability_version identify the producing adapter contract.

schema_compatibility_table.compatibility_behavior: A pointer never precedes its durable manifest; versions are reported as versions, not as separate current manifests.
schema_compatibility_table.identity_mechanism: partition_manifest_id plus a per-partition monotonically advancing manifest_version; supersedes_manifest_id chains revisions.

schema_compatibility_table.compatibility_behavior: UNKNOWN_REVISION is an honest state and never resolves to latest by default (query default policy is ERROR_ON_AMBIGUITY).
schema_compatibility_table.identity_mechanism: source_revision_key plus revision_number plus blob_sha256; revision_state names what the revision means.

schema_compatibility_table.compatibility_behavior: Verification and restore require exact equality with the supported pack version; any other value raises PackUnsupportedVersion. There is no cross-version migration.
schema_compatibility_table.identity_mechanism: PACK_SCHEMA_VERSION is the constant "1"; manifest_sha256 and pack_root_sha256 bind the pack.

unit_declaration_versioning.current_behavior_exact: Changing any fingerprinted input changes schema_fingerprint. Re-registering the SAME projection_schema_id + projection_schema_version with the changed declaration therefore raises ProjectionSchemaConflict. The only accepted way to ship a changed unit declaration alongside the old one is a NEW projection_schema_version (or a new projection_schema_id).
fingerprinted_inputs: SourceUnitEvidence.field_path (structural tuple; absent means the scalar path (field_name,))
unit_declaration_versioning.historical_stability: When NO declaration exists at all, the fingerprint formula omits both the source_unit_evidence list and the source_unit_contract key, so the resulting digest is byte-identical to the pre-I16R1 formula and historical descriptors keep verifying under their historical contract.
unit_declaration_versioning.rule: source-unit declarations participate in the schema fingerprint.
unit_declaration_versioning.what_bloc5_must_not_do: Do not assume a changed unit declaration is a compatible change; do not silently re-register an existing id+version; do not treat an unchanged version string as proof of an unchanged unit contract - compare fingerprints.
